Changes reach open screens right away; nobody needs to log out. "}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"1. Give the user the restaurant role","key":"md_1_give_the_user_the_restaurant_role","id":"1-give-the-user-the-restaurant-role","name":"md_1_give_the_user_the_restaurant_role","value":"# 1. Give the user the restaurant role In ERPNext (**User**), give each person the role **Restaurant User**. People with **Restaurant Manager** or **System Manager** can do everything in every restaurant and don't need anything else."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"2. Add them to the restaurant (Ren Staff)","key":"md_2_add_them_to_the_restaurant_ren_staff","id":"2-add-them-to-the-restaurant-ren-staff","name":"md_2_add_them_to_the_restaurant_ren_staff","value":"# 2. Add them to the restaurant (Ren Staff) **Restaurant workspace → Staff → New**. One record per person and restaurant: - **User** and **Restaurant**. - **Role**: what they may do there (below). Empty: the default role of **Ren Settings**; someone who is only given production centers gets the **Kitchen** role. - **Default restaurant**: where the POS opens when the person works at several. The first restaurant someone is added to is their default. They switch with **Work at** in the staff menu of the POS. - **Enabled**: turn off instead of deleting when someone stops working there. - **Access**: what they work: - a **Floor** gives its rooms and tables, - a **Room** gives its tables, - a **Table** gives just that table, - a **Station** (production center) gives its screen. Stations are always given one by one: a floor doesn't give its kitchen. > Someone who works several branches has one Ren Staff record per restaurant, each with its own role and access."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"3. Roles","key":"md_3_roles","id":"3-roles","name":"md_3_roles","value":"# 3. Roles A **Ren Role** is a set of permissions. Ren POS creates these to start with; edit them or add your own. | Role | Meant for | |---|---| | **Server** | Takes orders on their tables and charges them. Discounts, voids and price changes need a manager's PIN. | | **Bartender** | Any tab of their area, charges, small discounts (10 %). | | **Host** | Reservations, waitlist and seating. Doesn't charge. | | **Cashier** | Charges any order and runs the register. | | **Driver** | Takes delivery orders out; listed as a driver on the dispatch screen. | | **Kitchen** | Works the screens of their production centers. No tables, no charging. | | **Manager** | Everything, and approves other people's actions with their PIN. | Every permission is explained in [Role permissions](/Docs/Permissions). Two of them change what the access means: - **Every table of the restaurant**: the person works every table when no floor, room or table is assigned to them. If some are assigned, only those. - **Every production center**: every station's screen, without assigning them one by one."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"4. Charging","key":"md_4_charging","id":"4-charging","name":"md_4_charging","value":"# 4. Charging A role with **Charge orders** is not enough on its own, because ERPNext also checks who may create POS invoices. The person also needs: - the ERPNext roles **Accounts User** and **Sales Manager**, and - to be listed in **Applicable for Users** of a POS Profile of the restaurant (see [POS Profile and charging](/Docs/POS%20Profile)). The Ren Staff form shows an orange warning when something is missing. A System Manager can fix it with **Let them charge**."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"5. PINs, shared terminals and clock in","key":"md_5_pins_shared_terminals_and_clock_in","id":"5-pins-shared-terminals-and-clock-in","name":"md_5_pins_shared_terminals_and_clock_in","value":"# 5. PINs, shared terminals and clock in From the staff menu of the POS (the person icon at the top right), each person can: - **Set my PIN** (4 to 8 digits). A manager's PIN approves actions their role allows: see [Approvals](/Docs/Manager%20Tasks). - **Clock in / Clock out**. With **Staff must clock in to take orders** (Ren Settings), orders can't be taken before clocking in. - **My access**: what they may do and where. - **Switch user**: hands the device to someone else. **Shared terminals**: a manager opens the staff menu on the device and picks **Register this terminal**. With **PIN login on registered terminals** turned on in Ren Settings, staff then switch users on that device with their PIN instead of a password."}}]}]
